recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: reasoning benchmarks crossing forty-four percent for under a dollar
indie flashcard apps rerouting donation links around app store walls
september fog settling over san francisco before sunrise
first autumn morning — daylight already slipping earlier on the coast
agents spun up from a phone shortcut while the city sleeps

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Steer a lantern through rolling SF fog, scooping up agent sparks before they fade — each spark is a tiny task completed while you weren't looking.
composer-2.5-fast.touch_control: hold to slow time and drift, release to dash forward
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: each collected spark pops with a satisfying micro-completion chime; clearing a cluster in one dash feels like shipping before dawn
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: fog thickens, sparks spawn farther apart, and phantom obstacles drift in from the edges
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: muted watercolor fog with warm lantern glow and pixel sparks

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: A cost ticker drops cents while an ARC score bar climbs — tap exactly when the price hits zero to lock in the highest reasoning score before the round ends.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.touch_control: single tap on the beat of the dropping ticker
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: nailing a zero-cent tap triggers a score explosion and a one-line benchmark flex
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: ticker accelerates, fake-out dips appear, and the target window shrinks each round
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: terminal green on black with arcade score readouts

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Draw one unbroken wire from indie app icons to their tip jars while sliding app-store walls try to sever your path mid-stroke.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.touch_control: drag to draw a continuous line, lift to commit or fail
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: completing a clean route without crossing walls unlocks a cascade of tiny heart-donation particles
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: more apps appear, walls move faster, and previously safe corridors close off
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: paper cutout icons on a corkboard with red rejection stamps

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Autumn leaves fall in mismatched colors — flick each leaf into the correct hue bin before wind gusts swap its color mid-air.
gemini-3.1-pro.touch_control: flick leaves left or right into color-coded bins
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: a perfect streak of ten sorted leaves triggers a brief golden-hour filter over the screen
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: wind gusts reroute mid-flick, bins swap positions, and leaves fall in overlapping pairs
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: overcast september palette — slate sky, amber and rust leaves, soft grain
